Bridge between India and Sri Lanka
*101. SHRI C. P. THIRUNAVU-
KKARASU: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to construct a bridge between India and
Sri Lanka; and
(b) if so, whether Government have
dropped the scheme of "Sethu Samuthram
Scheme"?
Discontinuation of Centrally assisted
projects
†*102. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are going to discontinue the projects being
implemented with the Central assistance and
those being run by the Central Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what would be its likely impact on
development of the country;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the targets
fixed by Government have not been
achieved, so far; and
(e) the number of projects which have
not been completed as per its time schedule
and budget provisions?
Aid to new Afghan regime
*103. DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
sanctioned $ 200 million aid to the new
Afghan regime;
(b) if so, on what terms and conditions;
and
(c) what other steps have been taken to
establish economic, trade and diplomatic
relations with the new regime?
Identification of BPL families in H.P.
*104. SHRI  ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

the BPL families in Himachal Pradesh to be
covered under the targeted PDS;
(b) if so, the details thereof, District-
wise;
(c) whether all of them have been given
special ration cards; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Families covered under ‘Antodaya
Anna Yojana’
*105. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of families which have
been covered under the ‘Antodaya Anna
Yojana’ till 31st December, 2001, State-
wise; and
(b) the quantity of foodgrains
distributed to these families under the
scheme till the aforesaid date, State-wise?
Indo-US Joint Working Group on
Counter Terrorism
*106. SHRIMATI GURCHARAN
KAUR:
SHRI SATISH PRADHAN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the subjects discussed by the Indo-
US Joint Working Group on Counter
Terrorism during its recent meeting in
New Delhi;
(b) the decisions taken thereat; and
(c) the steps Government propose to take
to install high-tech sensors to detect cross
border human movements?
Award of excellence relating to labour
*107. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of LABOUR be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria of selection for the "Shram
Ratna, Shram Bhushan and Shram Vir"
awards of excellence relating to labour;
(b) the content of such awards;
(c) when these awards were established
and since then how many have been
awarded these awards, category-wise;
(d) whether it is a fact that BHEL
employees have got it for the last sixteen
consecutive years; and
(e) the composition of the Committee
for selection of such awards?
Increase in unemployment
*108. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ:
SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that unemployment
is gradually increasing in the country;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) what steps are being taken to wipe
out unemployment; and
(d) how many persons were registered
with various employment exchanges in the
years 1999-2000, 2000-2001 and  so far
in 2002 for employment?
Telephone facility in villages in Almora
District
*109. CHAUDHARY HARMOHAN
SINGH YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
telephone facility in Seem, Bungga,

Srikot, Kota and Majhali villages of Patti
Kaklashon in Almora District of
Uttaranchal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when this facility is likely to be provided in
these areas; and
(c) the steps being proposed by
Government for development of telephone
network and laying of optical fibre cable in
these areas?

Disbursal of loans by KVIC
754. SHRI C.P. THIRUNA-
VUKKARASU: Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission is granting loan to
provide employment to persons from
weaker section through Khadi Boards; and
(b) if so, the amount distributed and
persons benefited during the last two years,
State-wise?
Production of hand made paper
755. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether KVIC has any action
plan to promote production of hand
made paper in Andhra Pradesh which
is very popular abroad;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what incentives are being extended
to the producers of hand made paper in the
State?
Subsidies to Khadi producers
756. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the production capacity and
demand of Khadi;
(b) what steps have been taken by
Government to promote its export; and
(c) whether there is any plan to
provide subsidies to the Khadi
producers?
Loans to unemployed youths to
promote Khadi
†757. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
formulating any scheme to provide
loans to unemployed persons to
promote "Khadi";
(b) if so, the comprehensive details
thereof and by when the same is likely
to be implemented; and
(c) if not, in what manner Government
propose to promote "Khadi"?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

170
WIN2\SESSION\5129RS 170
Recruitments in KVIC
758. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Chairman of KVIC has
recently appointed about 40 'Khadi Experts'
ignoring all prescribed Government norms;
(b) if not, what criteria/norms were fixed
in each case;
(c) whether the Chairman has got
unfettered powers to make such recruitment;
(d) if not, the rules/instructions under
which, he is empowered to make such
appointments; and
(e) the names of SC, ST and OBC
candidates, selected against the reserved
posts?
Allocation of fund under PMRY in
Uttar Pradesh
759. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds allocated and
released by Government during the last three
years under the Prime Minister's Rozgar
Yojna in Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the details of the funds spent under
the scheme during this plan; and
(c) what steps are being taken by
Government to allocate funds to Uttar
Pradesh during the year 2001-2002?
Amendment in Atomic Energy Act,
1962
760. SHRI C.P. THIRUNA-
VUKKARASU: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring amendment in the Atomic Energy Act,
1962 to provide private participation in
country's nuclear power programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any expert committee has
been set up by Government to examine
'Ticklish'  issues involved in the matter;
(d) if so, the details thereof, alongwith
the recommendations of the committee; and
(e) Government's reaction thereto?
No fly zones over the nuclear
installation locations
761. SHRI K.C. KONDAIAH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to declare no fly zones over the nuclear
installation locations;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to take action in complete
coordination with the Ministry of Civil
Aviation; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Radiation facility for foodstuff
762. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of foodgrains and other
food commodities subject to radiation in the
country;
(b) how much foodstuffs are saved
annually by radiation technology indicating
the figures for vegetables, fruits, fish and
other grains; and
(c) the value of such food commodities
saved by way of radiation?

171
WIN2\SESSION\5129RS 171
Closure of Tarapur Atomic Centre
763. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the news report which appeared in
vernacular daily "Loksatta" dated the 21st
January, 2002 regarding closing of Tarapur
Atomic Centre by May, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Village telephones by telecom
companies

VUKKARASU: Will the Minister of
